name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta with Zucchini, Mushrooms & Peas

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1 cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons; thinly slice mushrooms. Place both in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.

When the veggies are done, add sun-dried tomatoes, cream, and spices to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce simmers, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add cooked pasta, Parmesan, basil, and peas to the pot with the veggies; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until cheese is melted and peas are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
Add reserved pasta water to the pot, a few tablespoons at a time, while stirring, to reach a saucy consistency (you may not need all of the reserved water). Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and enjoy!
